svg.title: AI-Roast-Battle
svg.desc: Postcard for AI-Roast-Battle (flutter app · gemini ai, Dart): Turns a photo into a witty AI roast, or judges a battle between two photos. Gemini writes roasts in 20+ character voices. Battle mode, showcase feed and image sharing. Secure proxy with Auth, App Check and rate limits. Built with Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Cloud Functions, Gemini AI, Cubit, Hive.
